messages:
Nina (CS): Kicking off LotusBridge onboarding. They want a 3-week pilot focused on: 1) KB embeddings in agent search, 2) auto-suggest replies for common refund tickets, 3) maintain p95 latency <200ms. Meera is the PM. Renewal touchpoint is ~49 days out, so capture clear ROI signals. Who can pick up integration, runtime, and enablement?

Meera (LotusBridge): Hi all 6; thanks! Top success metrics: 30% deflection on refund tickets, avg handle time down 25%, embedding precision@5 >0.7. We'll share a sanitized KB export and 48h of transcripts by EOD tomorrow. Pilot start target: 10 business days.

Owen (Solutions): I'll own integration + prompt tuning. Proposed milestones:
- Day0: access + mapping
- Day4: UI prototype + endpoint
- Day10: retrieval tuning + evals
- Day20: canary + collect metrics
Need to know auth (API key vs OIDC) and approximate token budget; I'll propose a sampled eval to control cost.

Hyejin (Eng): I'll cover runtime sizing, batching, and canary. Recommend hosted prototype; set up fallback private routing if compliance flags come up. Action for Meera: send avg concurrent agents and peak qps.

Carlos (Enablement): I'll prepare a 60m workshop, a short agent playbook, and a troubleshooting checklist. Request two support reps to participate in canary for shadowing.

invite-bot: Calendar invite "LotusBridge Onboard Kickoff" scheduled in 48h with Meera, Nina, Owen, Hyejin, Carlos.

Nina (CS): Risks: procurement/renewal review at ~Day49; embedding storage cost if full KB is ingested; private deployment adds ~2w to timeline. We'll prioritize renewal-linked metrics in weekly reports.

Owen (Solutions): Quick cost estimate: prototype sampling ~50k tokens/week; full pilot with heavy retrieval ~180k tokens/week. I'll supply a sampling plan.

Hyejin (Eng): Action items for Meera: KB export format, avg doc length, concurrent agents, PII status. Also confirm whether embeddings should refresh daily.

Meera (LotusBridge): Will send KB export + doc stats tomorrow morning. No PII in sample. Concurrent agents avg 9, peak 26. Daily embedding refresh OK for pilot.

Nina (CS): Pinning short summary:
``
Owners & Deadlines:
- Owen: integration + prototype (due Day4)
- Hyejin: runtime sizing + canary plan (due Day9)
- Carlos: enablement materials + workshop (due Day14)
- Meera: KB export + transcripts (due Day1/EOD)
- Nina: pilot dashboard & renewal-aligned metrics (due Day3)
Risks: procurement review ~Day49; Private deployment adds ~2w; embedding storage cost if full KB used.
Success criteria (LotusBridge): 30% refund deflection, 25% AHT reduction, precision@5 >0.7, p95 <=200ms
``
I'll create a one-pager and shared tracker after kickoff. Ping me to reassign owners. :white_check_mark:
